input.unit: One immutable occurrence_id; joins to chapter, working group, source and paper are many-to-one. Derived units are report/assigned-ID or report/raw-DOI key.

policy: One matched assigned ID per report. Preferred DOI must resolve to exactly one OpenAlex work and one nonmissing primary source. IDs with conflicting sources are excluded, not duplicated. All matched IDs remain the overall denominator.
